Batch: JoeWare LG, MachinePwd and NetSess publisher source review

Scope.AdFindAcceptance: Excluded from selected acceptance batches; no AdFind action in this review.

Findings: LG manages built-in, local and domain-local groups, including creation, membership, removal and comments; page version 1.03.0 dated 2010-04-26.
Permissions vary by operation; publisher notes Account Operator/Administrator access for AD modifications and delegated permissions may apply for member machines.
Publisher platform claims include Windows 2000, Server 2003/R2, Server 2008/R2 and XP; claims are historical and source code is unavailable.
MachinePwd changes the local machine-account password and can repair a broken secure channel; page version 1.00.0 dated 2012-06-07.
Requires administrator rights on the target and publisher explicitly calls for Run as Administrator with UAC enabled.
Publisher says Windows NT-based operating systems; no source code is available.

Sources.Finding: Usage exposes set-password, update-password, force-secure-channel-reset and combined fix operations. Behavior testing requires a disposable domain member VM and test domain account; no credentials or domain endpoint were used.

Findings: NetSess enumerates NetBIOS sessions on a local or remote machine; page version 2.00.00 dated 2004-02-01.
Normal use requires no special permission according to the publisher; full session details require administrator rights. Historical platforms end at XP and source code is unavailable.

Sources.Finding: Usage can query a named server/client and retrieve full session details; no endpoint was contacted.
